via_in_pad_turn_note: No published build-time change for via-in-pad/POFV. POFV is the free default for via-in-pad on 6-20 layer boards and charged on 4 layers (https://jlcpcb.com/news/free-via-in-pad-6-20-layer-pcbs-pofv); the 6-layer standard build times above (6-7 days, 5 days per the Aug 26, 2026 notice) therefore already cover POFV, but no page states an added delay for 4-layer POFV.

shipping_us-ao.method: Sea shipment (DDU, to carrier's US warehouse)
shipping_us-ao.from: JLCPCB factory via export sea port; sails every Thursday, closing every Friday

times_note: Build time runs from 'MI started' to production finished and ready for the shipping center; it excludes shipping (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/what-is-the-build-time). Standard-parameter orders paid before 6pm GMT+8 start the same day; orders paid after Saturday 18:00 GMT+8 or on public holidays start the next business day. PCBA total = PCB build + SMT time, with SMT prep done in parallel. Shipping days are JLCPCB's statistical estimates (90% of historical orders), not guarantees; the table's 'North American' column is used for US addresses. Read 2026-10-14.
hole_to_hole_source-s: JLCPCB PCB capabilities: Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.45mm; Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.2mm (no same-net / different-net split stated). https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 2026-10-21
silkscreen_source-s: JLCPCB PCB capabilities, Legend: Minimum Line Width "≥0.15mm" ("Characters width less than 0.15mm will be unidentifiable"); Minimum text height "40 mil (1.0mm)" ("Characters height less than 40 mil(1.0mm) will be unidentifiable"); preferred width-to-height ratio 1:6; pad to silkscreen 0.15mm. https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 2026-10-21. The height was 0.15 (the line width copied)
note: Standard capabilities reported. Advanced capabilities include minimum trace/space of 0.0762mm and minimum drill of 0.15mm. Hole-to-hole spacing is the published figure (hole_to_hole_source-s). Some silkscreen text parameters based on character design specifications.

https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/User-Guide-to-the-JLCPCB-Impedance-Calculator (material per layer count; er tables in images https://rs.jlcpcb.com/static/image/blog/pcb/nan-ya-plastics-np-155f.png and https://rs.jlcpcb.com/static/image/blog/pcb/shengyi-s1000-2m.png)
stackups_note: 616 named impedance-controlled stackup templates, every one JLCPCB's order-page template API returned for layers 2-50, board thickness 0.11-6.0 mm, outer copper 0.5-4 oz and inner copper 0.33-4 oz (only 4-32 layers, 0.4-4.5 mm, outer 1/2 oz and inner 0.5/1/2 oz returned any). The 'No requirement' default entry on each form is left out: it always repeats one of the named templates. Layer order, layer types and every thickness come from that API's iaminationList, the same data /impedance renders, for example 'Prepreg 7628*1 0.21040mm'. Thicknesses are copied as given; trailing zeros are dropped only by JSON number form. measured_total_mm is the exact sum of the layers and equals JLCPCB's own compressionThickness for all 616. Copper weight_oz is the template's cuprumThickness (outer) or insideCuprumThickness (inner); every core remark (H/HOZ, 1/1OZ, 2/2OZ) agrees with it. material and er follow the impedance-calculator user guide, which says 4-8 layer boards use Nan Ya Plastics NP-155F and 10-layer-and-up boards use SYTECH (Shengyi) S1000-2M, and gives that material's er table by prepreg glass style or by core thickness. For NP-155F the guide lists the prepreg row as '3313 (2313)', so 2313 also takes er 4.1, and cores thicker than 0.70 mm take 4.43. er is left out wherever the guide's table for that material has no matching row. On 10+ layer boards that is 75 7628 prepregs, 5 3313 prepregs and the 0.5 mm and 0.61 mm unclad cores. On 4-8 layer boards it is 67 0.075 mm cores, 34 106 prepregs, one 0.665 mm core and one 0.61 mm unclad core. Template layers of type 'lightPlate' are unclad cores with no copper; they appear as type core with a note-s. Checked against the five previously on file (taken 2026-08-26 from gsuberland/jlcpcb_autogenerated_stackups): JLC04161H-7628 and JLC08161H-2116 are unchanged except that measured_total_mm was rounded before (1.586 is now 1.5862 and 1.6 is now 1.5996). JLC06161H-3313: the middle 2116 prepreg is now 0.1088 mm, not 0.1164, so the total is 1.5384, not 1.546. JLC10161H-2116: the cores were filed as Nan Ya NP-155F with er 4.36, but per JLCPCB's 10+ layer rule they are SYTECH S1000-2M with er 4.42 (0.20 mm). The total was rounded before (1.589 is now 1.5886). JLC12161H-2313: the four inner 2116 prepregs are now 0.1118 mm, not 0.1194, so the total is 1.612, not 1.642. Its cores are S1000-2M with er 4.35 (0.15 mm), not NP-155F with 4.36. gsuberland's generator matched cores to the nearest thickness across both materials, so ties fell to NP-155F, and its table also lists S1000-2M 0.15 mm as 4.53 where JLCPCB's table says 4.35. Cross-check: JLCPCB's calculator database (POST /api/jlcTools/impedance/selectPageImpedanceDefaultTemplate, 5654 internal templates) also lists S1000-2M cores for JLC10161H-2116 (4.42) and JLC12161H-2313 (4.35). It gives S1000-2M 2313 as 4.27, where the published guide table says 4.31; the guide value is used here. That database stores pre-press prepreg thicknesses (for example 3313 at 0.107 mm), so it was not used for thickness, and its 4766 extra 4-32 layer templates are not offered on the order page. Left out: 60 stackups with a dielectric for which JLCPCB's tables give no er. Df / copper fields as in the 2026-10-15 profile (Nan Ya core 0.014-0.016; Nan Ya prepreg not published; Shengyi rows matched by glass style or core thickness and the 1 GHz Dk). Order: the five 1.6 mm stackups that were on file, then 14 / 16 / 18 layers nearest 1.6 mm, then the rest (the reader keeps the first 8, first of a layer count wins).
via_in_pad_note: POFV (plated over filled via) free on 6-20 layers; hole Min 0.20 mm / Max 0.50 mm, recommended 0.25-0.35 mm (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/via-in-pad-design-deep-dive, read 2026-10-06)
